pitfalls.readme_said: curl -fsSL .../latest/download/install.sh | sh installs on Linux x86_64
pitfalls.actually_needed: download zeph-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz + .sha256, verify, extract and symlink into ~/.local/bin

pitfalls.readme_said: install.sh downloads and verifies zeph tarball
pitfalls.actually_needed: install.sh fetches a prebuilt binary tarball which cannot be read as a script before running
